# eLearning Industry

> > eLearning Industry is the leading resource for discovering eLearning software, best practices, and thought leadership in corporate training and learning & development.

eLearning Industry serves as a comprehensive hub for L&D professionals, HR leaders, and EdTech vendors. The site aggregates expert articles, software reviews, webinars, and free resources on instructional design, AI learning applications, and training technology trends.

## Key Topics

- Learning Management Systems (LMS)
- Instructional Design
- AI in Learning
- eLearning Authoring Tools
- Learning & Development (L&D)
- Employee Development
- EdTech Software
- Content Creation
- Training ROI
- Professional Development
- ChatGPT & AI Tools
- Articulate 360
- TalentLMS
- Software Comparison
- Corporate Training
